name: visual
description: Explain your work in Visual and send approved messages back to the same Codex thread.

interface.shortDescription: Explain your work on a narrated whiteboard
interface.longDescription: Opens a narrated Visual whiteboard using this Codex session. Visual can ask read-only questions or show a message for your approval before sending it into this thread. Codex follows its existing permissions and mode. Answers and result summaries require local sharing approval.
